| [CASE-078](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-078.md) v2 | Who keeps placing on r/place: the proposed survival analysis of the released placement logs, testing whether participants return while their art survives and whether unaffiliated placement cools | Proposed by the owner on 2026-10-13, not run. On the released 2017, 2022 and 2023 logs, model each participant's hazard of stopping, with the survival of the art they placed into as a time-varying covariate, and estimate the rate of placements that fit no artwork over the event. The main threat is reverse causality: persistent defenders keep their art alive. So the design leans on destruction the participant did not cause, such as the 2022 moderator wipes and large raids. It is the test named in [CLAIM-274](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-274.md)'s defeater. | Active |

| [CASE-099](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-099.md) | The two-hypothesis coupled meaning–influence model linearized at its symmetric state: a meaning bias m and an authority bias a, each stable alone, coupled by authority shaping interpretation (β) and interpretation shaping endorsement (γ) | A14 §2 of the exchange of 2026-10-16. Near the symmetric state of the two-hypothesis, two-specialist model, (m, a) evolves by a 2×2 matrix J = [[α, β], [γ, δ]] plus noise. With nonnegative entries and α, δ < 1, the symmetric state is unstable exactly when βγ > (1 − α)(1 − δ), and the unstable direction mixes meaning and authority. Checked here. A construction about a linearization, not a fitted or simulated result. | Active |
| [CASE-106](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-106.md) | The two-hypothesis linearization with endorsement scored on committed predictions: when the shared meaning bends the specialists' predictions with weight κ and the reading of the evidence with weight κ′, the coupling of interpretation to endorsement is γ = 4ηs(κ′ − κ̄) | Built for [QUESTION-121](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-121.md)'s formal question: is scoring operators on predictions committed before the evidence equivalent to Regime B? The construction keeps [CASE-099](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-099.md)'s two-hypothesis linearization and replaces the score with squared error between each specialist's committed prediction and the evidence as read.
